task_summary: Dual-target flavonoid CADD pipeline against TTBK1 and MAO-B

steps.title: Review target disease biology
steps.description: Compile literature evidence for TTBK1 in pathological tau phosphorylation (AD/tauopathies, TDP-43/ALS) and MAO-B in dopaminergic and oxidative-stress pathways, using the literature and ChEMBL connectors. Record citations for the manuscript introduction.

steps.title: Select reference inhibitors per target
steps.description: Identify 2-3 experimentally validated positive controls per target with measured potencies from ChEMBL/BindingDB: a brain-penetrant TTBK1 azaindazole-class inhibitor, and safinamide plus selegiline for MAO-B. Save canonical SMILES and reported activity values.

steps.title: Fetch and inspect target structures
steps.description: Download 2V60 (MAO-B with safinamide and FAD) and 4NFM (TTBK1 kinase domain) from RCSB. Report resolution, chains, co-crystallized ligands, cofactors, gaps and the residues lining each active site.

steps.title: Screen candidate underexplored species
steps.description: Assemble 5-6 candidate Indian medicinal species with traditional neurological indications and confirmed flavonoid content (e.g. Evolvulus alsinoides, Desmodium gangeticum, Clerodendrum serratum, Sida cordifolia, Celastrus paniculatus). For each, compile reported flavonoid constituents from PubChem and IMPPAT-type sources.

steps.title: Quantify CADD literature footprint
steps.description: For each candidate species, count existing publications combining the species with docking/molecular-modelling terms, and separately with TTBK1 or MAO-B, using the literature connector. This turns the novelty claim into a measured quantity.

steps.title: Recommend species and build flavonoid library
steps.description: Rank candidates by flavonoid coverage against literature gap, recommend one species, and emit a curated SMILES library of its reported flavonoids with PubChem CIDs. Save the selection table as an artifact.

phases.name: Phase 1-2 — Receptor prep & validated baseline docking

steps.title: Prepare receptors
steps.description: Strip non-catalytic waters and crystallization additives while retaining the FAD cofactor in MAO-B, add polar hydrogens, assign Gasteiger charges, and write .pdbqt receptors with Meeko/OpenBabel. Define grid boxes centred on each co-crystallized ligand.

steps.title: Validate protocol by native redocking
steps.description: Re-dock each native co-crystal ligand into its own prepared receptor and compute heavy-atom RMSD against the experimental pose. Require RMSD below 2.0 A; if it fails, revise protonation or box size and re-run before proceeding. Report the achieved RMSD for both targets.

steps.title: Dock flavonoid library and controls
steps.description: Generate 3D conformers, MMFF94-minimize, and dock the plant flavonoid library plus reference inhibitors against both receptors at standard exhaustiveness. Record binding energies and set the benchmark score that generated molecules must beat.

steps.title: Map baseline interactions
steps.description: Profile protein-ligand contacts for the best baseline poses with ProLIF, checking TTBK1 hinge/catalytic contacts and the MAO-B FAD-adjacent aromatic cage (Tyr398/Tyr435). Save the baseline results table and interaction fingerprints.

steps.title: Stand up the generative route
steps.description: Attempt a REINVENT4 source install for scaffold-constrained generation on the flavanone core. If its dependencies cannot be satisfied in this sandbox, substitute RDKit scaffold-constrained R-group enumeration over medicinally relevant substituents and state the substitution explicitly in the methods.

steps.title: Generate candidate library
steps.description: Produce several thousand novel candidates that retain the flavanone/flavonoid core while varying R-groups, scoring each against a composite reward of predicted affinity for both targets plus synthetic accessibility. Deduplicate against the starting library.

steps.title: Dock-score and rank generated candidates
steps.description: Dock the generated library against both receptors, keeping molecules that improve on the Phase 2 benchmark for both targets. Save the scored candidate table.

steps.title: Compute drug-likeness and BBB filters
steps.description: Compute Lipinski and Veber descriptors, TPSA, WLOGP and the BOILED-Egg BBB-permeation criterion for all candidates. Eliminate non-BBB-permeant molecules, which is mandatory given both targets are intracranial.

steps.title: Apply PAINS and reactive-group filters
steps.description: Screen with the RDKit PAINS, Brenk and NIH substructure catalogs to remove pan-assay-interference and reactive false positives, reporting which candidates were removed and why.

steps.title: Run novelty check and select shortlist
steps.description: Query PubChem by exact structure and similarity to confirm shortlisted candidates are not already reported, so the novel-chemotype claim holds. Narrow to the top 10-20 dual-target hits and save the filter-cascade table.

steps.title: Re-dock shortlist at high exhaustiveness
steps.description: Convert shortlisted SMILES to 3D, MMFF94-minimize, and re-dock at maximum exhaustiveness with multiple replicate seeds against both receptors to assess score reproducibility and pose convergence.

steps.title: Profile and verify new interactions
steps.description: Confirm that generated functional groups form genuine new contacts rather than merely improving score: hinge-region and catalytic-residue contacts for TTBK1, FAD-adjacent aromatic cage for MAO-B. Cluster replicate poses and report occupancy of key contacts.

steps.title: Render pose and interaction figures
steps.description: Produce publication-grade binding-pose renders and 2D interaction diagrams for the leading complexes, loading the figure-style skill before rendering deliverables.

phases.name: Phase 6-7 — Molecular dynamics & binding free energy

steps.title: Build solvated MD systems
steps.description: Parameterize the top 2-3 complexes, solvate in a physiological water box with counter-ions, and write complete GROMACS topology and .mdp input sets for minimization, equilibration and production. These are deliverables regardless of whether compute is attached.

steps.title: Dispatch production MD to GPU compute
steps.description: Re-check available compute targets; once a GPU host is attached, dispatch 50-100 ns production runs per complex and collect trajectories. If no target is available, mark this step blocked and hand over the runnable input set rather than substituting synthetic trajectories.

steps.title: Analyse trajectories and compute MM-PBSA
steps.description: Extract RMSD, RMSF and radius-of-gyration traces, hydrogen-bond occupancy, and run gmx_MMPBSA binding free energy with per-residue decomposition, cross-checking the driving residues against the Phase 5 interaction map.

steps.title: Triangulate dual-target selectivity
steps.description: Quantitatively compare TTBK1 versus MAO-B engagement per candidate rather than asserting dual activity, and re-check toxicity liabilities (hERG, hepatotoxicity) with published rule-based models as a second pass beyond Phase 4.

steps.title: Rank final leads and build dossiers
steps.description: Rank the final 2-3 leads with a full dossier each: structure, pose, interaction map, MD stability where available, binding free energy where available, and ADMET profile. Flag them explicitly for future in-vitro enzyme-inhibition assays.

steps.title: Assemble figures and tables
steps.description: Compile the complete figure and table set: plant selection table, redocking validation, docking poses with interaction diagrams, filter cascade, dual-target comparison chart, ADMET profile, and MD plots if available.

steps.title: Draft the manuscript
steps.description: Write an IMRaD manuscript covering plant and target rationale, Phases 0-8 as the computational methods, results, and a discussion that explicitly states the limitations: docking-score predictiveness, flavonoid CNS-penetration risk, TTBK1/TTBK2 selectivity caveat, and absence of wet-lab validation.

steps.title: Recommend target journals
steps.description: Identify candidate computational/medicinal-chemistry journals that publish in-silico-only studies framed as hypothesis generation, with scope and recent-precedent notes for each.

desired_outputs: Plant selection table with flavonoid counts and CADD literature-gap metrics
Prepared receptor files (2V60 with FAD, 4NFM) as .pdbqt plus redocking RMSD validation report
Baseline docking results table: plant flavonoids and reference inhibitors vs both targets
Generated candidate library with docking scores and synthetic accessibility
Top dual-target candidate dossiers with poses and interaction maps
Publication-grade figures: poses, interaction diagrams, dual-target selectivity chart, ADMET profile
Ready-to-run GROMACS MD input set for top complexes
Draft manuscript in IMRaD structure with methods, results and limitations

feasibility.rationale: Phases 0-5 and 8-9 are fully computable here: Vina, RDKit, Meeko and ProLIF install from PyPI, and PDB/PubChem/literature access is available. Two caveats: REINVENT4 is not on PyPI and must be installed from source (if its dependencies fail in this sandbox I will substitute RDKit scaffold-constrained enumeration under the same docking+synthetic-accessibility reward, and label it as such), and SwissADME/pkCSM are web tools I cannot script, so ADMET will be computed from published rule sets (Lipinski, Veber, BOILED-Egg BBB, Brenk/PAINS) rather than scraped. Phases 6-7 MD and MM-PBSA are gated on the GPU compute you are attaching; the pipeline will stage runnable GROMACS inputs and dispatch once a target appears.
